body: Not much to say, really. It's a waterfall with a natural pool just next to the main road. Which is how we found it by coincidence as we were exploring on our rented scooter. Unless you feel like jumping in the pool for a cool-down I'd say it's best for just taking in the touristy scene (popular with both locals and tourists). If on a scooter, beware of the parking dude trying to charge you 200 for a 20 rupees parking fee ticket (the price is printed on the receipt) and the pushy dude trying to sell you some piece of rock by forcing it into your hands. Now, you kinda get the scene...Come to think about it, the monkeys on the main road down to the fall are way more fun to stop and watch. The macqaces(?) will let you get really close.
